title: Export job slows the database (chain)
reason: The diagnosis correctly identifies the db as the broken part, the config‑driven over‑frequent job as the problem, and the recent addition of the sales‑export job as the trigger.
root_cause: The sales-export job added 48 minutes ago runs a heavy COPY query every 5 minutes, saturating PostgreSQL CPU (97%) and causing statement timeouts that make API requests fail, leading to nginx 502 errors.
truth: The new sales-export job was meant to run daily but runs every 5 minutes. Its huge export query keeps PostgreSQL busy, so the api's queries time out, its workers are killed, and nginx answers 502. web and api only show the effect.
check_first: inspect the API container logs and its health status
